text: レッドモンド・ローバーズは65分に戦術を変え、相手ゴール近くで積極的にボールを奪いにかかるプレスを強め、より直接的な攻め方に切り替えました[#1190]。これで相手の攻撃チャンスはぐっと減り（相手のxGは0.97から0.17に）、反対にローバーズの得点見込みが0.28から0.91にアップしました。ボール保持率は少なくなったけど、相手陣内での支配が増えたということです。今から逆転に期待がかかります！

trace.output: Brief: Redmond Rovers change approach for fan audience in ja

- Redmond Rovers increased their press from 0.82 to 1.0 after the change [#1190]  
- Directness of play rose from 0.48 to 0.63 after tactical shift [#1190]  
- Redmond Rovers' xG increased from 0.28 before to 0.91 after the change [#1190]  
- Possession percentage dropped from 63.1% to 45.8% after the change [#1190]  
- Opponent (Ironvale Athletic) xG decreased from 0.97 before to 0.17 after the change [#1190]

- At 65 minutes, Redmond Rovers, trailing 1-2, shifted tactics by increasing their pressing intensity and line height while adopting a more direct style of play to chase the game. This reflects an attempt to disrupt Ironvale Athletic’s buildup and exploit quick transitions [#1190].
- The change led Redmond to reduce their possession share (from 63.1% to 45.8%) yet massively increase field tilt (60% to 80.6%), suggesting aggressive forward pressure and territorial dominance in the opponent’s half consistent with their 4-3-3 high press and quick circulation approach.
- Despite more directness and higher press, Redmond saw an uptick in high turnovers (from 1 to 2) but increased box touches (from 5 to 9), indicating they were creating more penetration into Ironvale’s penalty area through frequent forward deliveries or direct attacking sequences.
- Ironvale’s 5-3-2 with a low block and deep defensive line left them vulnerable to this pressing trap and direct play, as their counter-attacking threat diminished after the tactical change (opponent xG dropped from 0.97 to 0.17), showing Redmond’s high press was effective in limiting Ironvale’s vertical passing and counter opportunities.
